name: USPTO Open Data Portal
summary: The US Patent and Trademark Office's Open Data Portal: search US patent applications and grants, and read one application's bibliographic data, continuity, assignments, transactions and file-wrapper document list.

api_key.description: An Open Data Portal API key (data.uspto.gov > Manage API Key; needs a USPTO.gov account with MFA and a completed ODP profile), sent in the X-API-KEY header.

notes: Free, but rate limited per key; the limits are on data.uspto.gov/apis/api-rate-limits, which needs a signed-in USPTO.gov account to read. Keys of accounts with an incomplete ODP profile were deactivated in October 2026 and must be reactivated on the Manage API Key page.
Filed under government rather than science: these are the USPTO's public records of applications, grants and their prosecution history, not research literature.
Application numbers are digits only (14412875), without slashes or commas. Field names in q, filters, sort and fields are dotted paths such as applicationMetaData.filingDate.

endpoints.name: Search patent applications
endpoints.summary: Patent applications and grants matching a query, filters and date ranges, with facets.

q.description: Query with AND, OR, NOT, wildcards (*), quoted phrases, field:value, ranges [a TO b] and comparisons (>600). Empty returns the top 25.

filters.description: Field name, a space, then one value or comma-separated values, e.g. applicationMetaData.applicationTypeCode UTL,DES.

rangeFilters.description: Field name, a space, then from:to, for dates or numbers, e.g. applicationMetaData.grantDate 2010-01-01:2011-01-01.

sort.description: Field then asc or desc, e.g. applicationMetaData.filingDate desc.

facets.description: Comma-separated fields to count by, e.g. applicationMetaData.applicationStatusCode.

offset.description: Index of the first record, from 0.

endpoints.name: Get a patent application's full data
endpoints.summary: The full record the portal holds for one application; the sub-resource calls return its parts.

endpoints.name: Get a patent application's bibliographic data
endpoints.summary: Title, type, status, filing and grant dates, patent number, inventors, applicants, examiner and classification for one application.

endpoints.name: Get a patent application's parent and child applications
endpoints.summary: The continuity chain (continuations, divisionals, provisionals) of one application.

endpoints.name: Get a patent application's assignments
endpoints.summary: Recorded ownership transfers (assignors, assignees, dates) for one application.

endpoints.name: Get a patent application's prosecution history
endpoints.summary: Dated transaction events in the life of one application.

endpoints.name: List a patent application's file-wrapper documents
endpoints.summary: Documents in one application's file (office actions, responses, fee worksheets...) with document codes and official dates.

documentCodes.description: One or more comma-separated document codes, e.g. SRFW,SRNT.

officialDateFrom.description: Documents with an official date on or after this date.

officialDateTo.description: Documents with an official date on or before this date.

endpoints.name: Look up application status codes
endpoints.summary: Patent application status codes and what each means.

q.description: Search text or field:value; empty lists all.
